a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan only works if two rounds pass with no storm, about a 4% chance, so it almost certainly kills us both. The reserve holds just 4, enough for one unit right now. Once I hold 4, I will choose operate every round after that and never take again, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If we both grab, the split is random and we could both end up short.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the plan, but the storm odds made it almost certain to fail for both of us. From now on I will operate every round and never take again. If you operate too, the reserve gains 2 per round, so take 4 as soon as it reaches 4.
